name: 11e-convert-mistral-non-array
description: The non-array guard of convertMistralMessages (prompt-converters.js:704-706): a non-array argument returns a fresh empty list and is not touched. The object passed here is not a list, so the port's `isinstance(messages, list)` has to reject it BEFORE reaching `len(messages)`, the option read at :709 or the `messages[messages.length - 1]` dereference at :710 -- a port that only guards the later steps throws instead of matching. The empty-array case is 11d.
